scientific_integrity: Analytic unbounded proof and complete small-electorate exact-arithmetic reproduction; finite search corroborates but does not prove the general lower bound.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three candidates, unweighted approval ballots, exact harmonic PAV, set-valued winners. Historical priority not independently certified; larger candidate sets are not treated.
title: Ten voters are necessary and sufficient for tie-independent PAV house nonmonotonicity with three candidates
